evals.prompt: Prepare a dry-run plan for building the default Ubuntu host image with the create-image skill. Use the generic handheld ICT template and default paths. Check the prerequisites and explain exactly where the workflow stops if a required tool is unavailable; do not run a real clone, build, sudo command, or network call.
evals.expected_output: Provide a fail-closed precondition report and a dry-run build plan with default paths, working-template isolation, validation, the confirmation point, expected artifacts, and rollback guidance. Do not claim that an image was built.
expectations: Uses the default generic-handheld-os-template.yml and a separate work- template path, explicitly preserving the source template
Lists the documented prerequisite checks and says the workflow stops with an install hint when a required tool is missing
Describes the 2026.1-Release image-composer checkout, binary build, copied-template validation, and privileged build in the correct order
Places the only confirmation gate immediately before the privileged build and identifies expected .raw.gz/SBOM artifacts without claiming they exist
Includes cleanup guidance for the working template and failed partial output
